description:
Redwood Inference will deliver “Hosted data residency enforcement” as part of the Enterprise Security & Compliance Foundation initiative. The goal is to add customer-configurable region pinning for Hosted API (and aligned behavior for Dedicated where applicable), enforce residency at request time with deterministic checks, and return clear, actionable error messages when a request would violate residency policy.

Goals:
- Region pinning: allow an org/project (and optionally API key) to declare an allowed region set (e.g., EU-only) and a primary region.
- Enforcement: guarantee that request routing, fallback behavior, background processing, logging, and operational tooling do not move customer content outside the pinned region(s).
- Clear errors: when enforcement blocks a request, return consistent HTTP status codes and machine-readable error codes, plus human-readable guidance (how to fix, what config is wrong).
- Observability & auditability: residency decision logs (policy evaluation, selected region, block reason), dashboards, and audit-log events for config changes.

Scope:
- Hosted API routing layer + policy engine: introduce residency constraints into routing decisions; block cross-region fallback unless explicitly allowed.
- Control plane configuration: new residency policy objects, validation, and migration for existing customers.
- API gateway: request validation and consistent error contract; propagate “residency decision context” to downstream systems.
- Console/admin UX: surfaces to set and view pinning, view recent enforcement blocks, and configuration history.
- Documentation and enablement: public-facing docs updates (via docs repo/Confluence), security FAQ updates, and customer comms templates.

Non-goals (initial release):
- Automatic multi-region replication of customer data; advanced “geo-fencing” beyond request routing and logging boundaries.
- Full custom per-endpoint residency rules for every internal subsystem (handled via phased hardening and follow-ups).

Key stakeholders:
- Product: Naomi Feldman (Security & Compliance).
- Security: Marcus Lin (Security Engineering), Dr. Aisha Rahman (CISO), Olga Petrov (GRC) for evidence/controls.
- Engineering: Ethan Park (Platform Control Plane), Mina Haddad + Ravi Menon (Smart Routing), Amara Diallo (API Gateway).
- Reliability: Sean Gallagher (SRE) + Rafael Mendes (SRE Manager).
- Docs/Enablement: Elliot Price, Kira Thompson, Wei Chen.
- Field: Markus Klein (Solutions Engineering) + enterprise AEs (Avery Johnson, Hannah Schmitt) for customer rollout coordination.

Timeline (illustrative):
- Phase 0 (Discovery, 1–2 weeks): requirements, customer inputs, threat model, policy model.
- Phase 1 (Design, 2–3 weeks): PRD, architecture, ADRs, error contract, rollout plan.
- Phase 2 (Implementation, 4–6 weeks): control plane config + routing enforcement + gateway + tests.
- Phase 3 (Rollout, 2–4 weeks): internal dogfood, allowlist customers, progressive rollout by region, monitoring.
- Phase 4 (GA + hardening): docs finalize, security evidence pack, runbooks, post-launch retro.

Primary deliverables:
- PRD + detailed design and ADRs
- Policy schema + validation rules + migration plan
- Enforcement and error contract specification
- Runbooks, dashboards/alerts, and incident playbooks
- Customer-facing documentation updates and sales/security enablement materials

files.description: PRD covering problem statement, customer personas (EU regulated, enterprise), requirements (pinning, enforcement, auditability), non-goals, success metrics, and phased rollout plan.
Product design spec for residency policy objects (org/project/API key), Console settings UX, configuration history, and “blocked requests” troubleshooting views.
Formal internal policy describing how Hosted residency works, what is guaranteed, what is excluded, and how engineering controls map to compliance requirements (SOC2/ISO narratives).
ADR defining enforcement boundaries: what constitutes “customer content,” which subsystems are in-scope (routing, logs, traces), and explicit allowed cross-region metadata.
ADR for the public error contract: HTTP status, error codes, message templates, request-id linkage, and how SDKs should surface the error.
System doc for the control plane residency policy service: schema, API endpoints, auth, validation rules, rollout/migration strategy, and integration points with routing/gateway.
Internal how-to for engineers/SRE to set up pinning in staging, generate test API keys, and run verification scenarios.
Dashboards/alerts spec: metrics for blocked requests, policy evaluation latency, cross-region routing attempts, and per-region error rate deltas; includes alert thresholds.
Runbook for handling incidents where legitimate traffic is blocked: triage steps, feature flag overrides, customer comms guidance, and rollback procedure.
GRC-oriented evidence pack outline: controls, screenshots/links to dashboards, audit events, change-management artifacts, and test evidence for auditors/security questionnaires.
Sales/security enablement FAQ answering common questions (what is pinned, what isn’t, logs/traces handling, subprocessor regions, Dedicated vs Hosted differences).
Working doc aggregating customer asks (EU-only, APAC pinning), competitor comparisons, and open questions; links to call transcripts and CRM notes.
Engineering planning doc with milestones, owners, risk register, dependency map (gateway, routing, policy engine), and launch checklist.
Draft list of proposed metrics/events, naming conventions, and sample queries to detect cross-region attempts and measure block-rate by customer.
Sheet-style doc mapping cloud regions, internal region IDs, failover groups, and which services are permitted per residency tier.
Launch brief draft: positioning, target accounts, comms plan, enablement assets, and risks (false positives, support load).
PM ticket tracking PRD completion, stakeholder review, and sign-off gates; includes links to Confluence PRD and open questions list.
Defines product requirements for error messages, SDK surface behavior, and docs updates; acceptance criteria includes examples and localization constraints.
Control plane work item to add residency policy objects, validation, and admin APIs; includes migration plan and backward compatibility notes.
Routing enforcement ticket: integrate residency policy evaluation; ensure fallback respects allowed regions; add structured decision context to logs.
Gateway ticket to standardize error response (status/code/message), include request_id and policy_id, and ensure consistency across streaming/non-streaming endpoints.
Security/Platform ticket to emit audit log events for create/update/delete of residency policies and admin overrides.
Observability ticket to add counters/histograms, per-region breakdowns, and dashboards; includes SRE review checklist.
Adds end-to-end tests for pinned EU org hitting US endpoint, streaming behavior, and fallback scenarios; includes CI gating plan.
Design ticket for Console UX: residency settings page, confirmation modals, and troubleshooting UI for blocked requests with copy guidelines.
PR implementing residency policy schema, validation, migrations, and admin endpoints; includes tests and reviewer discussion on default behavior.
PR integrating residency policy into routing decisions and disabling cross-region fallback by default; includes logging fields for decision tracing.
PR adding deterministic enforcement response, standardized error payload, and docs-linked error codes for residency violations.
PR emitting audit log events and wiring into audit-log-exporter; includes security review comments and event schema discussion.
PR adding dashboards/alerts for blocked requests and policy evaluation latency; includes example queries and alert thresholds.
SDK PR mapping residency violation errors into a dedicated exception type with fields for error_code, request_id, and help_url.
Docs PR adding public documentation for region pinning configuration, limitations, and troubleshooting; includes example error payloads.
Customer ticket reporting unexpected cross-region fallback attempt; includes logs, investigation notes, mitigation (feature flag), and link to routing enforcement fix.
Support issue where customer enabled pinning and started receiving policy blocks; includes config review, guidance, and suggested allowlist changes.
Bug-style support ticket showing streaming path not returning standardized residency error; includes repro steps and linked gateway PR.
Internal request to enable feature flags and seed test orgs/keys for staging verification; includes approvals and validation checklist.
Transcript of an enterprise security review call focusing on data residency, audit logging, and regional failover; includes next steps and doc requests.
POC scoping call transcript for an EU-only hosted deployment; discusses success criteria, latency targets, and pinning enforcement behavior.
CRM company record for a regulated payments prospect requiring EU-only processing; notes include security review outcomes, blockers, and links to residency artifacts.
CRM record for a healthcare platform evaluating Hosted vs Dedicated with residency constraints; includes stakeholders, timeline, and technical requirements.
Email thread with a prospect after a security review: shares residency FAQ, confirms planned enforcement behavior, and schedules a technical deep dive.
Procurement/legal coordination thread discussing contract language for data residency and incident notification; includes redlines and internal questions to Security.
Internal email thread aligning Product/Security/Platform on the exact public error codes/messages and whether to expose policy identifiers.
Thread coordinating security review for residency enforcement: threat model questions, audit event schema, and approvals needed for GA.
Thread on control plane schema decisions: org vs project policy precedence, migration defaults, and rollout flags.
Architecture thread debating enforcement boundary (routing vs gateway vs downstream), how to handle model fallback, and failure modes.
SRE thread proposing dashboards/alerts, discussing expected block-rate, and defining paging thresholds for false positives.
Support escalation thread for a customer seeing confusing 500s; requests standardized residency violation errors and shares repro steps.
PM/Eng thread finalizing copy for error messages and Console UX, including terminology (“pinned region”, “allowed regions”) and help links.
Thread checking whether any runtime-side logging/tracing could leak content cross-region; lists mitigations and owners.
Incident thread where enforcement caused unexpected traffic drop in one region; includes mitigation, rollback considerations, and follow-up action items.
